title: DevSuperSuite Multi-Language SDK & Interactive Quickstart Code Samples
summary: Copy-pasteable configuration files, MCP server configurations, pre/post AST sliced code samples, and invariant test fixtures across 6 programming language ecosystems.

python.omnikernelrc:
[workspace]
name = "fastapi-payment-service"
language = "python"
root = "."

[slicer]
mode = "ast-simd"
strip_function_bodies = true
preserve_docstrings = true
preserve_type_hints = true
max_recursion_depth = 8
exclude = ["venv/", ".venv/", "__pycache__/", "*.pyc", ".pytest_cache/"]

[agentshield]
enforce_entropy = true
entropy_threshold = 4.50
block_test_deletions = true
test_directory_pattern = "tests/**/*.py"
posix_secret_exit_code = 1
posix_test_exit_code = 2
python.slicedAstSample:
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

class PaymentPayload(BaseModel):
    user_id: str
    amount_cents: int
    currency: str

class PaymentProcessor:
    def __init__(self, db: Session, key: str) -> None: ...
    def process_transaction(self, payload: PaymentPayload) -> dict: ...
python.testFixture:
import pytest
from services import PaymentProcessor, PaymentPayload

def test_process_transaction_valid():
    payload = PaymentPayload(user_id="usr_99", amount_cents=5000, currency="USD")
    assert payload.amount_cents == 5000
    assert payload.currency == "USD"

def test_process_transaction_negative_amount():
    with pytest.raises(Exception):
        PaymentPayload(user_id="usr_99", amount_cents=-100, currency="USD")
